title: Nested Loops
explanation: Put a loop inside a loop and you sweep a whole 2D area. The outer loop picks an x, and the inner loop runs through every z for that x.
A 7 by 7 area means the inner body runs 49 times. Multiply the two counts and you know how many blocks you are about to place.
Try changing size, or the block. Go easy on big numbers - every placement happens one at a time.
